boundary_rule: Capital Capability Gates may consume Control Plane evidence, but may never grant, weaken, bypass, or modify Control Plane authority.

capital_gates.note: No capital gate is defined yet. Gate criteria are written just-in-time, immediately before evidence collection for that gate (P4).

principles.name: Preregistered Gates
principles.mechanism: waves/*.yaml exit_criteria fixed before execution; no rule forbids post-hoc amendment

principles.name: Independence of Verification
principles.mechanism: runner/gates.py evaluate_gate: rejects agent PASS without probes/results/before-after digests; detects severity downgrade

principles.name: LIVE as Leased Capability
principles.mechanism: constitution/rules.json live_trading=false + runner/stops.py check_live_trading; lease itself not implemented

principles.name: No Progress Illusion
principles.mechanism: this file: enforcement status per principle; no readiness board

principles.name: Uncertainty Halts
principles.mechanism: constitution/rules.json fail_closed=true; runner/gates.py fails closed on missing/unloadable evidence; State.HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED

principles.name: Evidence Has Commit & Expiry
principles.mechanism: evidence before/after digests and commit_sha; STALE invalidation on dependency change not implemented

principles.name: Versioned Amendment
principles.mechanism: capital and governance documents versioned; control-plane CONSTITUTION.md versioned as of this change; no amendment log

control_plane_stop_condition_status.note: Verified by reading runner/stops.py and runner/fsm.py. Declared != detected (P9).

preexisting_capability_status.note: Capabilities that exist in UPTM predate this constitution. Under P12/P14 they are unverified against it, not unusable.
